rows.note: the domain edge's fan-out (enum type → every field-slot site whose recovered domain is the enum) is a goto-implementation projection, kept OUT of plain references.

goto-implementation on the requires 'fetch' atom fans out to every transitive composer's def — Composer directly, Deep through the SubRole hop. SubRole's own re-requires marker is a contract re-declaration, not an implementation, and must be excluded.
Same fan-out from $self->fetch inside the role body: the call resolves to the requires marker, then the composer walk.

goto-implementation on the `sub save` decl (a Sub{package} target, not a Method call) fans out to every override that participates in a concrete descendant's dispatch. My::Mixin overrides save on a SIBLING PARENT of My::Child (multi-parent `use base`), and My::Comp::Extra reaches My::Comp via `load_own_components` (current-package namespace) — neither is a descendant of My::Base, so the plain INHERITS_INV descendant sweep misses them (H7-7 DBIC Row::update shape). Base itself is the contract, excluded.
